body.statement: Does there exist a universal finite integer \(B\), independent of \(L\), \(\Delta\), compatible \(\zeta\), and \(v\in[0,1]\), such that both \(H_{\zeta}(v)\) and \(h_{\zeta}(v)\) are attained by a compatible hazard quadruple constant on at most \(B\) common subintervals? Establish the answer constructively: if affirmative, derive an explicit valid \(B\), prove equality with the finite optimization over \(\vartheta_B\), and characterize the optimizing incidence-survival tradeoff across normal, flat, singular, abnormal, and boundary regimes; if negative, construct a compatible family for which every exact optimizer has unbounded switching complexity. The mandatory early-kill instance is the positive-cell law \(\zeta_\star\) on the normalized unit bin at \(v=0\): within the \(z=w=1\) phase, analyze two complete repetitions of \((x,y)=(0,0),(1,0),(1,1),(0,1)\) under \(\Phi(\boldsymbol\theta)=0\). For the upper problem, \(\lambda_{\max}(\mathscr Q)>0\) is the constrained-Hessian sign for an improving local exchange, while an exact obstruction requires \(\mathscr Q\preceq0\) together with \(\max_{\overline{\mathcal T}_\star}\mathcal G_0>\max_{\partial\overline{\mathcal T}_\star}\mathcal G_0\); the lower problem uses the reversed signs.
body.justification: This is the theorem-level kernel: it decides whether the exact active-ceiling sharp frontier is a fixed-dimensional elementary program, and the specified two-cycle Hessian test can kill an invalid compression claim before mesh or inference work obscures the obstruction.
body.gap: Kim2023CompetingRisks supplies sequential nonlinear programs for a different discrete latent-duration model, while LasserreHenrionPrieurTrelat2008 supplies only convergent measure relaxations and ZhuTrelatCerf2016 shows that generic smooth control problems may chatter; none resolves endpoint-preserving finite compression for the hazard-spliced frontier.
body.consumer: A positive result makes exact ceiling-indexed grouped-data separable-effect bounds auditable for monthly competing-event analyses such as the SPRINT kidney-injury example in StensrudHernanTchetgenRobinsDidelezYoung2021; a certified two-cycle obstruction identifies the precise complexity barrier and forces a pivot rather than a gridded surrogate.

obligation.what_is_open: Prove or refute a parameter-uniform bound \(B\) on the number of common constant-hazard pieces needed by exact optimizers when both nuisance hazards are saturated and the two remaining controls may follow repeated alternating four-corner cycles; then assemble this with flat, singular, abnormal, and boundary regimes.
obligation.obstruction: Compactness proves existence of a measurable optimizer but supplies no uniform switching complexity. The switching-function derivatives bound the nuisance switches, yet in the phase \(z=w=1\) with both factual-incidence multipliers negative they permit repeated \((0,0),(1,0),(1,1),(0,1)\) cycles. Neither endpoint dimension nor piecewise-constant approximation preserves the four factual endpoint equalities and the support objective exactly, and no cycle-deletion inequality or optimal repeated-cycle counterexample has been certified.
obligation.attempted: The mandated two-cycle word was evaluated by exact elementary exponential recursions. At the equal-duration feasible point its constraint Jacobian has rank five and the explicit tangent in the partial result changes the objective with both signs, so that point is not a stationary obstruction and a constrained Hessian test there is inapplicable. Single-control singular intervals were exactly pulse-compressed. Direct switching-function and bracket calculations exclude the proposed simultaneous interior singular candidate as a source of an optimizer, but they do not bound the number of alternating bang cycles. Finite-grid and restricted-family calculations were not used as global certificates.
obligation.partial_result:
The prescribed two-cycle calculation can be completed exactly at the reference schedule, but it does not yield the universal compression theorem.  Put \(q=e^{-1/8}\), and evaluate every piece by
\[
 V^+=Ve^{-(a+b)\ell},\quad\quad P^+=P+VaE(a+b,\ell).
\]
At \(\boldsymbol\theta_\star=(1/8,\ldots,1/8)\), direct differentiation of these eight elementary updates gives, for the minor of \(D\Phi(\boldsymbol\theta_\star)\) formed by columns \(1,\ldots,5\),
\[
 \det D\Phi_{[1:5]}(\boldsymbol\theta_\star)
 =\frac14q^{27}(q-1)^2(q+1)^2(q^2+1)^2>0.               \tag{12}
\]
Thus the feasible set is locally a three-dimensional smooth manifold.  The explicit vector
\[
 d=\left(-\frac{2q^4}{q^2+1},0,-1,0,
          \frac{2q^4}{q^2+1},0,1,0\right)^{\mathsf T}
\]
satisfies
\[
 D\Phi(\boldsymbol\theta_\star)d=0,
 \quad\quad
 D\mathcal G_0(\boldsymbol\theta_\star)d
 =-q^3(q-1)^2<0.                                         \tag{13}
\]
The implicit equations therefore have feasible curves through \(\boldsymbol\theta_\star\) with tangents \(d\) and \(-d\); all durations remain positive for sufficiently small curve parameter.  Equation (13) proves that the reference two-cycle schedule is neither an upper nor a lower constrained stationary point, so no constrained-Hessian obstruction can occur there.

A second exact partial compression covers an isolated single-control singular interval.  If \(y=z=1\) on an interval of length \(\ell\) and \(m=\int x\), then \(S/S_1\) is constant, so factual and hybrid cause-1 increments differ by a fixed multiplier.  Every measurable \(x\in[0,1]\) with total \(m\) has factual increment between
\[
 e^{-(\ell-m)}\frac{1-e^{-2m}}2
 \quad\text{and}\quad
 \frac{1-e^{-2m}}2.
\]
A unit pulse of length \(m\), starting at \(\eta\in[0,\ell-m]\), has increment \(e^{-\eta}(1-e^{-2m})/2\), so a choice of \(\eta\) matches the original interval exactly with at most three pieces.  The symmetric statement holds for a single free \(y\) when \(x=w=1\).  These calculations do not control a phase in which \(z=w=1\) and both \(x\) and \(y\) execute an arbitrarily long alternating four-corner word.
